text: 金十数据9月25日讯，据外媒报道，泰国的出口以四年来最快的速度增长，受益于与全球人工智能热潮相关的电子产品，以及中国对泰国榴莲和山竹的需求激增。根据商务部周五的数据，8月份的出口同比增长24.3%，是56个月以来的最高增幅，7月份为21.6%。进口增长25.1%，低于上个月的36.7%。贸易逆差从7月份的36亿美元缩小至25亿美元。最新数据显示，商务部预测泰国今年的出口将创下新纪录。随着全球科技公司加大对人工智能基础设施的投资，占出口近三分之一的电子产品预计将继续成为主要驱动力。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 25 - According to foreign media reports, Thailand's exports grew at the fastest pace in four years, benefiting from electronics related to the global AI boom and a surge in Chinese demand for Thai durians and mangosteens. According to Ministry of Commerce data on Friday, exports in August rose 24.3% year-on-year, the highest increase in 56 months, compared with 21.6% in July. Imports rose 25.1%, lower than 36.7% the previous month. The trade deficit narrowed to $2.5 billion from $3.6 billion in July. The latest data show that the Ministry of Commerce forecasts Thailand's exports will set a new record this year. As global tech companies increase investment in AI infrastructure, electronics, which account for nearly one-third of exports, are expected to remain a major driver.
